title: A look at creators and organizations warning of AI's existential threats to humanity; some organizations sponsor social media posts and partner with influencers (Nitasha Tiku/Washington Post)
summary: Nitasha Tiku / Washington Post: A look at creators and organizations warning of AI's existential threats to humanity; some organizations sponsor social media posts and partner with influencers — Warnings about the potential for artificial intelligence to escape human control could be coming soon to an influencer near you.
